AboutPage.title: Explore the Boundaries of AI — Your Personal Productivity Compass
AboutPage.subtitle: Hi, we're Heguang Studio. Welcome to our distraction-free AI workshop.
AboutPage.story1: As heavy AI users and developers, we grew tired of cluttered bookmarks and hype-driven tool lists. We believe in a clean, fast, and distraction-free digital toolbox, where useful tools and quality content always come first.
AboutPage.story2: That's why Heguang Studio built iChengHub. Rather than a commercial directory, it started as our internal toolkit opened up to everyone—designed to be a productivity hub that helps you cut through the noise of the AI era.
AboutPage.feature1Desc: We focus on quality over quantity. Every listed tool is reviewed by our team to filter out low-effort clones and keep the directory genuinely useful.
AboutPage.feature2Desc: Production-ready prompts tested in real workflows.
AboutPage.wechatDesc: Scan to follow for AI tool reviews and updates
AboutPage.xiaohongshuDesc: AI productivity tips and indie developer notes
AboutPage.ctaText: If you've discovered a great tool or have a workflow challenge you'd like solved, we'd love to hear from you.
